metadata.title: Build Deterministic Card Detail Extraction Pipeline

story.iWant: the CLI/API to click each tenant card and capture detailed fields deterministically
story.soThat: `--details` mode returns enriched tenant data backed by the new investigation findings
story.tasks: - Wire detail pipeline - Implement card iteration using `a.hfpxzc` locator and new timing helper - Ensure navigation back to directory view and state recovery - Extract DOM fields - Map selectors from investigation memo to scraper helpers - Normalise phone, website, status via existing utility functions - Parse protobuf payloads (optional enrichment) - Create parser leveraging captured `.bin` samples (document assumptions) - Merge protobuf data into tenant dict when present - Throttling & configuration - Add settings knobs for inter-card delay, retry counts, and max cards - Update CLI flag help text to describe runtime impact - Tests & docs - Add unit/integration tests consuming stored fixtures - Update README + architecture section with detail-pipeline behaviour

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. `scrape_tenants(..., fetch_details=True)` iterates cards with documented timing (0.5 s settle, 2 s post-click, 2 s between cards). 2. Each tenant yields enriched fields (name, category, rating, phone, website, hours, status, maps link) via selectors from the investigation memo, with graceful fallbacks. 3. Protobuf payloads from `outputs/st-james-quarter/card-investigation/` are parsed when present to enrich canonical contact data. 4. Throttling mitigations exist (configurable delays, retries, card cap) and are documented. 5. Regression coverage (fixtures/tests) and README/architecture updates describe the detail extraction workflow.

story-context.constraints: - Follow investigation guidance: attribute-based selectors (`data-tooltip`, `aria-label`, `jsaction`) are more stable than class names. - Load states must use `domcontentloaded` plus explicit sleeps; `networkidle` is unreliable on Google Maps. - Maintain 2 s inter-card delay and configurable retries to avoid throttling. - Keep `_extract_detailed_tenant_data` modular; avoid further bloat in `scraper.py` by delegating to helper functions if necessary. - Preserve baseline directory extraction performance; detail mode must be opt-in via `--details`.

tests.standards: Use pytest with asynchronous helpers; prefer fixture-driven tests that operate on stored HTML/protobuf data rather than live Google Maps requests. Follow existing patterns in tests/test_scraper.py for exercising private helpers.
tests.locations: tests/test_scraper.py; tests/test_parser_snapshot.py; add new fixtures under tests/fixtures/card_details/
tests.ideas: - AC1: Fixture-based test ensures `scrape_tenants(..., fetch_details=True)` waits the documented intervals before gathering fields. - AC2: Unit test verifies DOM extraction functions pull phone/website/hours from stored HTML snippet referencing selectors in memo. - AC3: Parser test loads sample protobuf `.bin` file and asserts canonical phone/website merge into tenant dict. - AC4: Configuration test checks adjustable inter-card delay and card cap behave as expected. - AC5: CLI integration test confirms `--details` flag writes enriched JSON/CSV without affecting baseline output shape.
